note: The six fixtures of quickstart.md, with stub agents; no test calls a model. FX-PAR-S (spec 142) stays the fixture set of the layer itself.

fixtures.stubAgents: a stub proposer that ticks tasks
setup: a task list with two runs of consecutive [P] tasks naming disjoint paths
fixtures.observe: the doctor and launch --dry-run print byte-identical plans with serial reasons and the ceiling statement
fixtures.mustNotObserve: no slot, record or worker after printing; nothing under parity
fixtures.when: as often as needed; first case of every trial is the frozen events of 153

fixtures.stubAgents: a stub proposer; a stub critic that approves
setup: a phase whose plan holds three groups
a quota window above headroom for one group
for P3: two frozen groups with disjoint scopes and independent by PG-1; a third whose acceptance check fails
fixtures.observe: all three groups start in plan order; the group above headroom stays serial with `headroom`; g-23-1 of the 153 replay starts once; the failed check refuses with `group-check` and repairs serially
fixtures.mustNotObserve: a group restarted over unchanged paths; a merge check after 0 applied paths; a critic call while a worker tree exists
fixtures.when: as often as needed; first case of every trial is the frozen events of 153

fixtures.stubAgents: two stub runs on one host
setup: a slot record whose owner is dead
fixtures.observe: no two full check-set executions overlap; the dead holder's slot is reclaimed, the live one never; the wait is a pause of class host_slot that spends nothing
fixtures.mustNotObserve: a stop while waiting; a budget or count moved by the wait
fixtures.when: as often as needed; first case of every trial is the frozen events of 153

setup: a contract with a stage group {A, B}, width 2, no never_together
then a landing conflict for B
fixtures.observe: A and B run at once in workspaces of their own; A lands after the gate on the rebased tree; B is parked with exit 22, home unchanged
fixtures.mustNotObserve: a model call for the landing; a merge commit; a critic call on the rebased tree
fixtures.when: as often as needed; first case of every trial is the frozen events of 153

fixtures.stubAgents: a stub proposer; a stub critic
setup: phases 2 and 3 declared independent with disjoint scopes
fixtures.observe: both are worked at once in trees of their own; phase 2 is gated, judged and committed first; phase 3 is rebased onto it before its gate
fixtures.mustNotObserve: the workspace changing before a verdict; two gates at once
fixtures.when: as often as needed; first case of every trial is the frozen events of 153

fixtures.stubAgents: a stub critic that approves 1 in 12; then one that rejects
setup: loop.speculate on at the default window and rate; then a fixture with the rate above 50 %
fixtures.observe: at 1 in 12 no speculative unit starts and `rate` is recorded; above the rate phase n+1's tree exists while n is judged, integrates on approval, and is set aside with no count moved on rejection
fixtures.mustNotObserve: a critic-class call reading the speculative tree; an outer counter moving; a revert of the workspace
fixtures.when: as often as needed; first case of every trial is the frozen events of 153

fixtures.stubAgents: none: the fake binary of the conformance suite (XII)
fixtures.setup: the dsh adapter fake-binary test with N = 4 concurrent sessions on one configuration home
fixtures.observe: the home is byte-identical before and after; the adapter records concurrentSessions as tested only with this test, the recorded live check and its pin
fixtures.mustNotObserve: a file of the operator configuration written; a harness named in a rule
fixtures.when: with every change of an adapter

trial.stubAgents: the stub agents of the six fixtures
trial.setup: each fixture run twice by scripts/trial.mjs: the switch off, then only that switch changed; the frozen events of 153 as the first case
trial.observe: the sets of exit codes, stop reasons and run states with the switch on are subsets of those with it off; no breach invariant of F142-FR-071 fails; every rule test passes; the report reproduces 336, 29, 274 of 386 and 28 repair on the frozen events
trial.mustNotObserve: a forecast; a file written by the report; any output under parity
